items.signal_prefix: CFO: Electronics sales growth accelerated to +10% in Q2 as p

set.signal: CFO: Electronics sales growth accelerated to +10% in Q2 as prior-year equipment and installation comparables rolled off, driven by carrier gas startups and ramp-ups mainly in China and Taiwan and broad-based momentum in advanced materials (Air Liquide's proprietary molecules). One South Korean customer pulled a Q3 order forward after the legal and IT merger of DIG Airgas and Air Liquide Korea; normalised for this, underlying Electronics growth was +8%. CEO: 'some customers are catching up a little bit with advanced purchase', and there 'may be a little bit of this effect on the advanced material'.
